newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLL - ENSO H1 PROFIT SEEN LOWER.
newsitem.headline: POLL - ENSO H1 PROFIT SEEN LOWER.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 955 million markka median forecast for Finnish forestry group Enso Oy's first half 1997 profit after financial items, before extras and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 17 analysts, EPS by six analysts).
Enso's January-June report is due on August 13, tentatively at 1000/0700 GMT.
Enso this year shifted to quarterly reporting from tertials.
In January-June 1996, it had a proforma 1,116 million markka profit after financial items. In January-March this year it posted a 480 million markka profit.
In March, Enso said it expected earnings in 1997 to match the 1996 level.
The median of 14 analysts' forecasts for Enso's full-year 1997 profit was 1.90 billion markka (mean 1.88 billion) in a 1,425-2,286 million markka range.
Enso's full-year 1996 profit after financial items was 1.66 billion markka.

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aros Securities, Aktia Bank, Carnegie Securities, Goldman Sachs, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Enskilda Securities, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
